Office flower subscription questions

How much does an office flower subscription cost?

It depends on the number of arrangements, how often we visit and your city. Share those details and we will send a quote with the full monthly cost.

Where do you offer the office flower subscription?

Add your city or pincode to the quote form. We confirm whether we cover your office before you commit to anything.

Who sets up and replaces the flowers?

Our team does. On each visit we place the fresh arrangements and take away the old ones.

Do you provide vases?

Yes, if you need them. Tell us in the quote form and we will include vases with the first setup.

Can we pause during office holidays?

Yes. Tell us before your next visit and we will pause or skip it.

Can you cover more than one office?

Share each location in the quote form and we will confirm which ones we can cover.

How are we billed?

You get one monthly invoice for all your office flowers.

Do you also create floral gifts for clients and teams?

Yes. Mention it in the note on the quote form and we will send options with your quote.
